summary: Frontend-only continuation completed on public URL with mobile-first browser checks (390x844 + 320x844). Verified create loop closure flow, GPS explicit-stop behavior, finish dialog branches, preview behavior, publish flow, and cross-screen regressions (Explore/Favorites/Profile/Walk detail). Backend suite was intentionally not re-run (previous 34/34 pass retained).

ui_bugs.issue: At a displayed gap of 20 m, finish dialog appeared instead of direct preview in one controlled GPS run.

integration_issues.issue: Could not conclusively validate zero /api/routing/snap calls after publish due intermittent preview opening timeouts in dedicated logging run.

action_items: Investigate boundary logic for stop gap at exactly 20 m (displayed 20 m should follow <=20 m branch per requirement).
Stabilize preview-open timing/state around close-loop + preview-route to remove intermittent timeout path in automation.
Main agent should self-verify publish network trace: ensure no /api/routing/snap is fired after successful publish navigation.
critical_code_review_comments: useRouteRecorder.ts usableFix() correctly enforces accuracy<=25m, stale fix rejection, min gap, and max speed constraints; explicit stop-only behavior observed in tests.
useWalkCreation.ts stop() + finishReturn() preserve draft on completion failure and allow continue-recording, matching expected failure resilience.
RoutePreview/FinishDialog testID coverage is strong and supports deterministic e2e checks.
Google map integration emits expected deprecation warnings for google.maps.Marker; not a functional blocker now but migration to AdvancedMarkerElement is recommended by Google.

success_rate.frontend: 87% (core requested flows mostly verified; one boundary mismatch + one inconclusive publish-snap assertion)

seed_data_creation: Created at least one UI walk during validation: 'TEST boucle retry' (published successfully). Additional comments/ratings added on demo walk during regression checks.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Physical native device testing was NOT performed (web preview only). GPS scenarios used in-browser geolocation injection (test harness only). One forced /api/routing/snap 502 was injected to verify failure preservation and continue behavior. Re-run no-snap-after-publish check with stabilized timing and explicit request log assertions.
rca_of_issue: Potential threshold/display mismatch: stop logic branches on gapToStart(saved) > 20, while UI text rounds distance to nearest meter. A true value slightly >20m can display '20 m' and still trigger finish dialog, creating perceived rule violation. Mitigation: compare with tolerance (e.g., >20.5), or display precise value/threshold hint to align user expectation.
